result.title: Readout and Operating-Point Sensitivity in Event-Stream Candidate Selection
result.summary: Event-triggered recording needs a useful combination of target capture and false triggers, yet representation comparisons can change with readout and threshold calibration. We evaluate real event accumulations from 520 DailyDVS-200 clips and 47 participants using participant-disjoint training, validation, and testing. The original study varies frozen encoder scale, accumulation duration, and temporal view count; a post-review extension adds two supervised-pretrained convolutional encoders, a 61,586-parameter trained CNN with three seeds, ten repeated participant partitions, and calibration sensitivity. At 50 ms/eight views under the primary handshake-or-fall policy, DINO-S CLS captures 101/132 targets with 40/388 false triggers, versus 78/132 and 35/388 for patch mean. DINO-B CLS has lower selected-threshold capture but higher fold-wise low-FPR partial AUC (0.746 versus 0.732). MobileNetV3-Small captures 97/132 with 53/388 false triggers, demonstrating why lightweight baselines and actual operating points matter. Across ten dependent repartitions, mean normalized partial AUC is 0.738 for DINO-B CLS and 0.674 for MobileNet. The original LeJEPA S-to-B capture difference is 8.3 points, but its multiplicity-adjusted interval includes zero. Duration and view-count effects remain policy dependent. We find no established JEPA-specific advantage. The evidence concerns offline action-defined candidate selection on previously used development data; it does not establish personal recording value, continuous false alarms per hour, or eyewear energy.

AI.brief_summary: 该文在 DailyDVS-200 事件流片段上比较冻结编码器（DINO、MobileNet、LeJEPA 等）用于“是否触发录制”的候选选择，系统考察读出方式（CLS 与 patch 均值）、累积时长、视角数、阈值校准及重复划分对捕获率与低误报部分 AUC 的影响，并报告未发现 JEPA 特有优势。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“读出方式与工作点会改变表示比较结论”的负面结果及多重比较校正做法，可能启发 LVR 中比较 latent 内容（池化选择、阈值设定、低误报区间指标）与触发/停止决策评价时的可核查方法学风险，但不涉及语言模型推理本身。
